notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted attribute. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM object and data-element declarations, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time configuration when applicable, and application object class and attribute names. It verifies typed deletable-object counts at zero, one, and two live registrations and after deletion, reliable RTI-originated reflection metadata, standard handle/name lookups, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, diagnostics, periodic timers, or wall-clock assumptions.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard MOM object-attribute request with FederateAmbassador reflectAttributeValues callback
